description: Use the newly supplied keyway, full lever and side-profile close-ups for apartment 210, following the earlier request to refine its handle/lock. Preserve door-210 stable ID and measured 79-inch leaf height. Add detailed lever/rosette/key cylinder geometry and a linked hardware record if appropriate, attach selected metadata-free photos, document observed features and identity uncertainty, retain previous door evidence. Do not assert manufacturer, exact model, part number or dimensions without support. Validate, publish, verify the model and photo record, close ticket and give a targeted human check.

comments.text: Added a nested door-hardware-210 component: stepped rose, hub, flattened swept blade, two-lobed keyed-insert surround and generic keyway. User reports the handle is in the wrong place during local preview. Stop publication until placement is checked against the full-door photo and the new hardware close-ups. Current nested hardware retained old estimated center; distinguish actual geometry placement from camera-focus errors.

Also fixed editor focus to use world orientation and selection to choose the nearest nested component. Browser verified the full-door position, hardware popup and exterior focus.
